selection: fixed TRAIN only; sole prior uncertainty qmin_conflict
justification: Magnetics-only EFIT01 does not constrain central current like MSE. The earlier 1.05 conflict systematically flags ECE-supported trains near 1.1-1.3, and 5% of the prior TRAIN candidates sit above 1.74. A prescribed 1.4 conflict threshold leaves this bias band unresolved by the equilibrium. High q is no longer sufficient for absence: sustained q_min >= 1.5 supplies only the q-prior state absent_q_prior, which is uncertain on export and supplies no benchmark negative. Thresholds are not fitted to expert or test results.
